pages.text: $(bold)Jar$(): right-click with items to fill the 4 slots in order - recipes must be arranged correctly.$(br)When the recipe is right, $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to seal it and start pickling/fermenting.$(br2)Nothing can be changed while sealed; when a batch finishes the next one starts automatically until the output slot is full.

$(bold)Shift-right-click$() to unseal, refunding all materials and results.$(br)After unsealing, $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to collect the results.$(br2)If the recipe is wrong the seal won't work and you'll get a hint - check the arrangement.
